Eric, saw GiveCampus rolled out GC Intelligence and new ways for younger alumni to give.

More product surface usually means more in-market institutions in play than the sales team can cover before reps ramp, and that is where deals stall. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for GiveCampus off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes to walk you through it?

With over 1,000 schools already on the platform, the next number means reaching the right institutions before peers do, and pipeline pressure tends to outrun headcount. Most teams cannot actually say how many meetings they need to hit target, so the gap surfaces late.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings GiveCampus needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
